title: Nibble Ltd
description: A playful, memorable visual identity for Nibble, a cookie brand built around tiny treats and big happiness.
fullDescription: Nibble needed a complete brand system that could capture the charm of its small-batch cookies across packaging, digital touchpoints, and promotional moments.
overview: We created a warm, energetic identity for Nibble, pairing a friendly wordmark with cookie-inspired illustrations, a cheerful colour palette, and flexible visual assets.
challenge: The brand needed to feel playful and appetite-inducing while remaining clear and distinctive across small packaging, social media, and event materials.
strategy: We established a rounded, expressive visual language with a clear hierarchy, memorable iconography, and a flexible palette that brings each flavour and campaign to life.
solution: The finished brand gives Nibble a cohesive visual foundation across its logo, packaging, digital presence, and promotional assets, making every customer touchpoint feel recognisably Nibble.
